title: MPU-6050 IMU
prompt: an MPU-6050 IMU on a GY-521 breakout: power it, tilt it, watch the raw gyro drift and the accelerometer jitter, then switch on the complementary filter; see-through labels the sensor chip, I2C pins and 3.3 V regulator
blurb: A GY-521 breakout on a tilting cradle, wired to an Arduino Nano over I2C: tilt it and watch the integrated gyro angle drift away while the accelerometer angle jitters, until a complementary filter blends the two into one steady reading.
